# Town of Franconia, New Hampshire
> Demo redesign. Not the official site. Official site: https://www.franconianh.gov/ (franconianh.org redirects there).
> Values in [brackets] are unknown. Homepage events are posted town and library notices for the week of October 26, 2026.
> The furnace-and-ridge mark and the silhouettes are original drawings, not traced from landmarks or surveys.

## Data
- [town.json](https://dzajic.github.io/franconia-nh-gov/pr-preview/pr-23/town.json): sections, events, contacts, bodies
- [archive/index.json](https://dzajic.github.io/franconia-nh-gov/pr-preview/pr-23/archive/index.json): one record per imported document
- Document files resolve under https://pub-436583bfa32248cb9f7762118b829267.r2.dev (ARCHIVE_BASE_URL). PDFs are not in the git repository.
- Town clerk phone: 603-823-5237. Email: townclerk@franconianh.gov. Hours: Closed Mondays. Tuesdays–Thursdays 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Fridays 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m..
